families.name: Food-price-pressure forecast
families.source: PSA CPI food and all-items index, monthly (OpenSTAT 0012M4ACP22)
families.availability: months through month 2 of quarter t (published before O(t))
families.transformation: latest index held flat to the target months of t+k, YoY against the same months a year earlier; minus the province's frozen 2021-22 P60 food and gap thresholds (lead-specific)
families.missing: NaN if fewer than 2 base months are published or before 2021

families.name: Headline inflation above the usual level
families.availability: latest two published months (months 1-2 of t)
families.transformation: headline YoY minus the province's 2021-22 headline P60 (firi.HEADLINE_P60)
families.missing: NaN if either month is missing

families.name: Poverty and population density
families.source: PSA SAE 2021 poverty, POPCEN 2024 population, land area
families.availability: treated as a static structural profile at every origin (served FIRI Amendment 1; strictly published 2025)
families.transformation: 0.6 x min-max poverty + 0.4 x min-max density

families.name: PAGASA El Nino alert/advisory in force
families.transformation: 1 if an El Nino Alert/Advisory is in force, else 0
families.missing: 0 before the first item (2023-03-24; La Nina/none in 2021-22)

families.name: Palay/corn production drop
families.transformation: -(lower of palay and corn YoY %, t-1 vs t-5)

families.name: Unemployment change (national)
families.transformation: quarter-mean unemployment rate t-1 minus t-5 (points)

families.name: Remittance decline (national)
families.missing: NaN before 2022-Q2 and after 2025-Q4 (series not acquired beyond)

families.name: Food Stress Sentiment Index (FSSI-v3)
families.availability: admitted headlines of quarter t published before O(t)
families.missing: NaN when fewer than 5 admitted headlines (status not SUFFICIENT); never zero

families.name: Regional hunger outlook above 11.3%
families.source: SWS Balance Luzon involuntary hunger, approved rounds
families.transformation: P(hunger at t+k > 11.3) = 1 - Phi((11.3 - latest reading) / sigma_k), sigma_k = RMSE of the same rule's earlier lead-k errors (thesis_system.regional_hunger)
